ns2:section.sectionText: This specific course is designed to understand various food systems and how they affect agricultural development and societal progress. In this first series of classes on food systems, this course will focus on chocolate and explore this sweet delicacy from bean to bar to cultural icon. Learn the history, harvesting, processing, and production of chocolate in this interactive course. This course also has an optional study abroad component that will travel to Ecuador and see the full process. See FSHN 398 FSC CRN: 72145 for the study abroad option.
